criteria.criterion: Cloud: a converted ADF description posts once; a second pass emits zero updates (test_cloud_cutover_sends_structured_adf + test_lossy_body_converges_across_passes)
DC: issue.update(fields=…) gets rendered wiki, not raw Markdown; a second pass emits zero updates (test_dc_cutover_sends_rendered_wiki + test_cutover_does_not_mass_rewrite_already_synced_bodies)

TWO distinct compares: emit on the plain inbound-decoded remote; baseline compares' LOCAL side through normalize_outbound to match decode(baseline_wire); a no-edit body stays suppressed across passes, a rebar edit shows changed, a legacy body upgrades once then converges (test_lossy_baseline_compare_local_normalized, test_legacy_body_upgrades_once, test_lossy_body_converges_across_passes)
The WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefinition leaves the DC comment-diff dedup key unshifted; comment-diff converges with no duplicate re-post (test_diff_comments_cutover_neutral.py, all 4 tests)

Outbound fires only on a rebar-originated change (local != baseline); the baseline advances via _advance_baselines; a benign re-canonicalization converges in one re-emit, no re-GET (test_echo_rebar_origin_only, test_recanonicalization_converges_within_one_reemit)
A Jira-authored construct (panel/mention/date) survives a later rebar pass under origin-gating (test_jira_native_construct_survives_an_edit_free_pass)
A concurrent both-sides body edit keeps rebar's body (local-wins) AND raises the outbound-field-conflict alert, recording the remote value (test_concurrent_conflict_alerts)
An inline change-gated 8-byte rich_sha is stored, no per-pass timestamp, changing 0 entries on a no-op pass; ≤0.07 KB/version asserted on the serialized per-binding delta (test_rich_reemit_state.py)
Flag-gated, defaults OFF (opt-in per client, not a 100%-traffic flip), reverting to the plain/identity wire when off (test_cutover_defaults_off, test_cutover_rollback_restores_plain)

With the marklas extra absent, the cutover path emits the plain-text ADF wire (today's behaviour), raising nothing; verified by test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas (rich=True, adf._marklas stubbed to None) and test_dc_degrades_without_pandoc
